review: 606.5-1: variant no_carth changed two facts (Carth absent and the -1 activated instead of the +1); it now removes only Carth, so A still activates the +1 and Garruk ends at 4.
606.6-1: base expected left Gideon Jura on the battlefield at 0 loyalty; added that it goes to the graveyard under 704.5i before the ability resolves, which still destroys the Bears.

606.6-2: base expected stopped at Garruk reaching 0 loyalty; added its state-based move to the graveyard, Carth's 'planeswalker you control dies' trigger (library stated empty) and the -4's resolved +3/+3 and trample.

scenarios.title: A loyalty ability is legal only at sorcery timing, on its controller's turn, once per permanent per turn

setup.notes: Jace Beleren has 3 loyalty counters and has not activated a loyalty ability this turn. In the stack_not_empty variant the stack holds {'card': 'Runeclaw Bear', 'controller': 'A'}.

decisions: A, with priority, activates Jace Beleren's +2 (each player draws a card).
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: sorcery_timing
variants.expected: Activating +2 is legal (can_play true); Jace has 5 loyalty counters and each player draws a card.

variants.label: second_activation
variants.delta: A already activated Jace Beleren's -1 earlier this turn (it resolved).
variants.expected: Activating +2 is illegal (can_play false): Jace already activated a loyalty ability this turn.

variants.label: opponents_turn
variants.delta: B is the active player in main1; A holds priority.
variants.expected: Activating +2 is illegal (can_play false): it is not A's turn.

variants.label: stack_not_empty
variants.delta: A Runeclaw Bear spell controlled by A is on the stack.
variants.expected: Activating +2 is illegal (can_play false): the stack is not empty.

variants.label: combat_phase
variants.delta: The step is beginning_of_combat instead of main1.
variants.expected: Activating +2 is illegal (can_play false): it is not a main phase.

scenarios.title: A loyalty ability's cost adds or removes loyalty counters
decisions: A activates Gideon Jura's +2 targeting B, adding two loyalty counters as the cost.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: plus_two
variants.expected: Gideon Jura has 8 loyalty counters (the counters are added on activation) and creatures B controls must attack Gideon during B's next turn.

variants.label: minus_two
variants.delta: A activates the -2 targeting B's tapped Grizzly Bears instead.
variants.expected: Gideon Jura has 4 loyalty counters and the tapped Grizzly Bears moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: zero
variants.expected: Gideon Jura still has 6 loyalty counters (the cost adds none) and becomes a 6/6 creature until end of turn.

scenarios.title: Several loyalty-counter costs combine into one net addition or removal

setup.notes: Garruk Wildspeaker has 3 loyalty counters. Carth the Lion: planeswalkers' loyalty abilities you activate cost an additional [+1].

decisions: A activates Garruk Wildspeaker's +1 targeting both tapped Forests; the cost is the +1 plus Carth's additional +1, two counters.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: plus_one
variants.expected: Garruk has 5 loyalty counters and both Forests untap.

variants.label: minus_one
variants.delta: A activates the -1 (create a Beast) instead, its cost combined with Carth's +1.
variants.expected: Garruk has 3 loyalty counters (the combined cost is a net change of zero) and a 3/3 Beast token is created.

variants.label: no_carth
variants.delta: Carth the Lion is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Garruk has 4 loyalty counters and both Forests untap.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge applies Carth's RaiseCost as an extra AddCounter cost part; confirm it nets against the SubCounter part.

scenarios.title: A negative loyalty cost can't be paid without enough loyalty counters
decisions: A activates Gideon Jura's -2 targeting B's tapped Grizzly Bears.

variants.label: two_counters
variants.expected: Activating -2 is legal (can_play true); Gideon Jura has 0 loyalty counters and moves to A's graveyard in the state-based check before the ability resolves; the ability still resolves and the tapped Grizzly Bears moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: one_counter
variants.delta: Gideon Jura has 1 loyalty counter instead of 2.
variants.expected: Activating -2 is illegal (can_play false): there are not enough counters to remove.

scenarios.title: An additional loyalty cost is counted when checking whether a negative cost can be paid

setup.notes: Garruk Wildspeaker has 3 loyalty counters. Carth the Lion adds [+1] to each loyalty cost. A's library is empty.

decisions: A activates Garruk Wildspeaker's -4 (creatures A controls get +3/+3 and trample).

variants.label: with_carth
variants.expected: Activating -4 is legal (can_play true): the total cost removes 3 counters (-4 plus Carth's +1). Garruk has 0 loyalty counters and moves to A's graveyard in the state-based check; Carth's dies trigger fires and finds nothing in the empty library; the -4 then resolves and Carth the Lion is 6/8 and Runeclaw Bear 5/5, both with trample, until end of turn.

variants.label: without_carth
variants.delta: Carth the Lion is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Activating -4 is illegal (can_play false): the cost removes 4 counters and Garruk has only 3.
